Definition: Suppliers are systems, people, organizations, or other sources of the materials, information, or other resources that are consumed or transformed in the process.
Inputs are materials, information, and other resources provided by the suppliers that are consumed or transformed in the process.
The process is the set of actions and activities that transform the inputs into the outputs.
Outputs are the products or services produced by the process and used by the customer.
Customers are persons, groups of people, companies, systems, and downstream processes that receive the output of the process.
